description: Line-by-line port of Bioconductor DECIPHER 3.9.4 ConsensusSequence for DNA, RNA or protein: the least frequent characters are dropped while they represent less than `threshold` of the sequences and the rest are encoded with an IUPAC degeneracy code (DNA/RNA) or B/Z/J/X (protein); `noConsensusChar` where the consensus carries less than `minInformation`. Gaps '-'/'.', masks '+', terminal gaps ignored unless includeTerminalGaps, unequal lengths allowed. Cross-checked against DECIPHER's own R/C source (10,000/10,000).

threshold.description: Fraction of information that may be lost per position, in [0, 1) (default 0.05)

ambiguity.description: Split IUPAC degeneracy codes between their residues (default true)

noConsensusChar.description: Single character of the alphabet for positions without consensus (default '+')

minInformation.description: Minimum fraction of information in (0, 1]; default 1 - threshold

includeNonLetters.description: DECIPHER includeNonLetters (default false: gaps/masks counted; true: left out)

consensus.description: DECIPHER consensus (length of the longest sequence)

errors.message: At least one sequence is required
noConsensusChar must be exactly one character
